'''Nogometni klub Šenčur''' ({{langx|en|Šenčur Football Club}}), commonly referred to as '''NK Šenčur''' or simply '''Šenčur''', is a Slovenian [[association football|football]] club based in [[Šenčur]] that competes in the [[Slovenian Third League]], the third tier of Slovenian football. The club was founded in 1951.<ref name = "Klubi"/>"}}
